stemMarkdown: Two runners start together from the same point on a circular track 600 m long and run in opposite directions at 5 km/h and 2 km/h. After how many seconds do they meet for the first time? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Running in opposite directions their speeds add: $1.9444$ m/s. Together they must cover one full lap, so they meet after $\dfrac{600}{1.9444} = 308.5714$ seconds.
